admin_recovery_request.name: Admin recovery request
admin_recovery_request.description: Normally leave blank. To reset only the HPS login, enter a new unique value (letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores; up to 64 characters), save and restart. Create a new HPS login, then clear this field. Dashboards, uploads, connection and license remain.

network.3000/tcp: HPS browser, tablet and Android access. HPS login required.
